description: Gold rental/not_rental labels for unique (non-duplicate) posts from the 2026-07-18 export. Sources: human = user corrections; auto_agree = fixed-regex label confirmed by a confident cross-validated TF-IDF model (verified ~99% pure on a hand-audited sample); claude_review = hand-labeled by Claude (all model/regex disagreements + low-confidence posts). Policy: seeker posts, sales, and commercial properties (shops/offices/parking) = not_rental; sublets, vacation rentals, and roommate-room offers = rental. Ambiguous posts excluded.
